title: Merge branch 'master' into tostringtag
body:
This rebases PR <https://github.com/heycam/webidl/pull/357> on top of master using a merge commit.

To resolve this, simply fast‑forward `tostringtag` to the tip of my [`EB‑Forks:fix/only‑install‑tostringtag‑on‑prototype`](https://github.com/EB-Forks/webidl/tree/fix/only-install-tostringtag-on-prototype) branch.

---

The diff against master is the same as in <https://github.com/heycam/webidl/pull/860>.

[Preview](https://pr-preview.s3.amazonaws.com/EB-Forks/webidl/pull/861.html) | [Diff](https://pr-preview.s3.amazonaws.com/heycam/webidl/861/31871e8...EB-Forks:c490402.html)
